fullPassage: When we get an unfavorable outcome, in some ways the last thing we want to hear is that the process was fair. As outraging as the combination of an unfavorable outcome and an unfair process is, this combination also brings with it a consolation prize: the possibility of attributing the bad outcome to something other than ourselves. We may reassure ourselves by believing that our bad outcome had little to do with us and everything to do with the unfair process. If the process is fair, however, we cannot nearly as easily ______________ the outcome; we got what we got “fair and square.” When the process is fair we believe that our outcome is deserved, which is another way of saying that there must have been something about ourselves (what we did or who we are) that caused the outcome. *consolation: 위로

det.korean: fair: (A) 공정한(형용사) — (B) 박람회/축제(명사). 문맥에 따라 뜻이 갈리는 다의어
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 박람회 — (B) 박람회: (A)는 경기를 '공정하게' 유지한다는 형용사
❌ ② (A) 박람회 — (B) 공정한: (A)는 형용사 '공정한', (B)는 명사 '박람회'로 서로 뒤바뀜
❌ ③ (A) 공정한 — (B) 공정한: (B)는 조랑말·먹거리가 있는 '박람회(명사)'
✅ ④ (A) 공정한 — (B) 박람회 — (A) fair=공정한(형용사), (B) fair=박람회(명사) ←정답
det.tip: fair = 공정한(형용사) / 박람회·축제(명사). 관사 a 뒤에 오면 명사

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "to explain something as being caused by a particular person or thing"

det.korean: attribute = ~의 탓으로[덕분으로] 돌리다. 본문 'attributing the bad outcome to ~'
det.analysis:
✅ ① attribute(~의 탓으로 돌리다) — 어떤 일을 특정 사람·사물이 원인이라고 설명하는 것 ←정답
❌ ② reassure(안심시키다) — 걱정을 덜어 주는 것
❌ ③ deserve(~을 받을 만하다) — 자격이 있음을 뜻함
❌ ④ combine(결합하다) — 둘 이상을 합치는 것
det.tip: attribute A to B = A를 B의 탓으로 돌리다

questions.passage: We may reassure ourselves by __________ (believe) that our bad outcome had little to do with us and everything to do with the unfair process.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: believe → believing. 전치사 by 뒤에는 동명사(-ing)가 와야 함
det.analysis: 빈칸 앞에 전치사 by(~함으로써)가 있어요. 전치사 뒤에는 명사나 명사 역할을 하는 동명사(-ing)가 와야 하므로, believe를 believing으로 바꿔야 해요. 'by believing ~'은 '~라고 믿음으로써'라는 뜻이에요.
det.tip: 전치사(by) + 동명사(believing) = ~함으로써

questions.passage: As outraging as the combination of an unfavorable outcome and an unfair process is, this combination also brings with it a consolation prize: the possibility of __________ (attribute) the bad outcome to something other than ourselves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: attribute → attributing. 전치사 of 뒤에는 동명사(-ing)가 와야 함
det.analysis: 빈칸 앞에 'the possibility of'가 있어요. 전치사 of 뒤에는 명사 역할을 하는 동명사(-ing)가 와야 하므로 attribute를 attributing으로 바꿔요. 'the possibility of attributing ~'은 '~의 탓으로 돌릴 가능성'이라는 뜻이에요.
det.tip: 전치사(of) + 동명사(attributing) = ~하는 것의

questions.passage: When we get an unfavorable outcome, in some ways the last thing we want to hear is that the process was fair. As outraging as the combination of an unfavorable outcome and an unfair process is, this combination also brings with it a consolation prize: the possibility of attributing the bad outcome to __________. We may reassure ourselves by believing that our bad outcome had little to do with us and everything to do with the unfair process. If the process is fair, however, we cannot nearly as easily ______________ the outcome; we got what we got “fair and square.” When the process is fair we believe that our outcome is deserved, which is another way of saying that there must have been something about ourselves (what we did or who we are) that caused the outcome. *consolation: 위로
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 나쁜 결과를 '우리 자신이 아닌 다른 것(something other than ourselves)' 탓으로 돌릴 가능성
det.analysis:
❌ ① our own honest mistakes(우리 자신의 정직한 실수) — 오히려 우리 탓이라 위로가 되지 않음
❌ ② the fairness of the trial(재판의 공정성) — 불공정한 과정을 탓하는 흐름과 반대
✅ ③ something other than ourselves(우리 자신이 아닌 다른 것) — 나쁜 결과를 남 탓으로 돌려 스스로를 위안함 ←정답
❌ ④ the passing of time(시간의 흐름) — 문맥 무관
det.tip: attribute the bad outcome to something other than ourselves = 나쁜 결과를 우리가 아닌 다른 것 탓으로

questions.passage: When we get an unfavorable outcome, in some ways the last thing we want to hear is that the process was fair. As outraging as the combination of an unfavorable outcome and an unfair process is, this combination also brings with it a consolation prize: the possibility of attributing the bad outcome to something other than ourselves. We may reassure ourselves by believing that our bad outcome had little to do with us and __________. If the process is fair, however, we cannot nearly as easily ______________ the outcome; we got what we got “fair and square.” When the process is fair we believe that our outcome is deserved, which is another way of saying that there must have been something about ourselves (what we did or who we are) that caused the outcome. *consolation: 위로
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 나쁜 결과가 우리와는 거의 관련 없고 '불공정한 과정과 전적으로 관련(everything to do with the unfair process)' 있다고 믿음
det.analysis:
❌ ① nothing to do with the result(결과와 아무 관련 없는) — 결과 자체를 부정하는 어색한 말
✅ ② everything to do with the unfair process(불공정한 과정과 전적으로 관련) — 앞의 'had little to do with us(우리와는 거의 관련 없다)'와 대비되어 남 탓으로 돌리는 흐름 완성 ←정답
❌ ③ little to do with our effort(우리 노력과 거의 관련 없는) — 앞 구절과 중복되어 대비가 안 됨
❌ ④ something to do with pure luck(순전히 운과 관련된) — 본문의 '불공정한 과정' 대신 '운'을 끌어들여 무관
det.tip: little to do with us ↔ everything to do with the unfair process = 우리 탓은 적고 과정 탓은 크다

ch: nothing to do with the result
everything to do with the unfair process
